meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Retrieves and analyzes Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) release data, including CRISPR Chronos gene effects, cancer model annotations, omics biomarkers, and PRISM drug sensitivity. Supports cancer-selective dependency, co-essentiality, and candidate synthetic-lethality analyses with release-aware identifiers and statistical checks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从癌症依赖图谱里筛出关键基因与候选药物靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在做癌症基因组或药物靶点研究,要分析依赖图谱数据
copy.tagline_en: Screen cancer dependency data for key genes and candidate drug targets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study cancer genomics or drug targets and analyze dependency data

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查询并分析 DepMap 的癌症依赖数据:CRISPR Chronos 基因效应打分、细胞系注释、组学标志物与 PRISM 药物敏感性,并做选择性依赖、共依赖和合成致死分析。
howto.when: 当你要求验证肿瘤靶点、查找癌症选择性依赖或合成致死基因对,或分析化合物敏感性时触发。

say.text: 查一下 KRAS 在肺癌细胞系中的 Chronos 依赖性打分
say.note: 返回该基因在各细胞系的打分数值

say.text: 找出 BRCA1 突变细胞系中更必需的基因(合成致死)

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude can query and analyze DepMap data: CRISPR Chronos gene effect scores, cell line annotations, omics biomarkers, and PRISM drug sensitivity, plus selective-dependency, co-essentiality, and synthetic-lethality analyses.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to validate an oncology target, find cancer-selective dependencies or synthetic-lethal gene pairs, or analyze compound sensitivity.

say_en.text: Is KRAS a selective dependency in lung cancer cell lines? Give the scores.
say_en.note: Returns Chronos dependency scores per cell line

say_en.text: Find genes more essential in BRCA1-mutant lines (synthetic lethality).
say_en.note: Compares mutant vs wild-type gene effect

say_en.text: Compute the top 20 co-essential partners of EGFR.
